2026-10-08.text: Today I believe the only ridable spot is Squamish, 1pm to 5pm, with 18 to 19 kt SSW gusting 23. Not much else until tomorrow, which looks like a fun, strong NW system coming in. Stay tuned!

2026-10-07.text: Jericho may see some low teens wind in the afternoon for those in big gear and kite foiling, and I believe Squamish will see some thermal winds late in the afternoon, around the high teens and maybe gusting over 20. Not much more in the area, so keep an eye on the sensors.

2026-10-06.text: Marine clouds will settle in the area, which could make Squamish work better. I think Squamish will see high teens and low twenties again, and possibly more if the sun hits for longer hours there. I don't see much else ridable in the area, so head over to Squamish and enjoy the sun!

2026-10-05.text: Not much ridable wind in the area today other than Squamish, which will develop a thermal in the afternoon. I would say high teens gusting to the low twenties, and maybe more with the help of the pressure gradient today, depending on cloud cover in the afternoon. Looks clear, and that should bring some wind.

2026-10-04.text: If you're looking for more than 18 knots, today is the day for golfing. I think the only viable forecast, at sub 18 knots, will be Squamish, and it will depend on cloud cover. The inflow shows as coming, however I believe it will be in the mid teens and possibly gusting sub 20 knots in the late afternoon. I don't see ridable wind anywhere else in the area.

2026-10-03.text: Looks like the NW winds are back and will bring some wind to Jericho in the high teens, maybe gusting 20. If you want a sure bet, Squamish will work. It will most likely bring low 20s or high teens in the afternoon, a bit more if the sky remains clear and the temperature heats up. The pressure gradient is inverted so that will slow things down, but sunny in Squamish may win!

2026-10-01.text: Today nothing looks rideable. The best is Porteau from 15:00 to 16:00, 6 to 7.5 kt from the north, at 12% to 19%. Looks like a rest day!

2026-09-30.text: The only place that may see some wind today is Squamish. The pressure gradient shows an inversion, however the temperature thermal difference may bring wind if the cloud cover doesn't get in the way. I'd guess it'll be on the lighter side of things, mid teens to high teens, and if it works, it would be later in the afternoon.

2026-09-29.text: A frontal system is coming across and looks like it will bring ridable winds early in the morning. White Rock will probably be around 20 knots, but it looks like the system is east of metro, so the center will be messing things up as it crosses. It will switch to SW and then WNW, and depending how far inland it goes we may see some winds at the Ferry Terminal and Stevenson's around the high teens or low twenties. If the system goes a bit more east, the tail end may also touch Jericho and it could be fun. Very weird looking day as winds are switching, so reliability will depend on how far east the system passes.

2026-09-28.text: Not an 18kt day, but probably worth a session. The SE should fill in somewhere between noon and 2pm at 16 gusting 21. Those hours lean on EC, though, which has been running about 4kt too high for us, so I'm expecting 12 to 16 and bringing the big wing. Boundary Bay gets the wind first, but the tide is too low to foil until about 3:30pm, so White Rock East Beach is my pick from lunch on. Tuesday morning could be the real day, with EC calling SE 20 to 30.
